topography.project_purpose: Blackhole is an Avalanche decentralized exchange protocol with both AMM and concentrated-liquidity AMM (CLMM) components. It supports token swaps, liquidity pool creation and management, LP position infrastructure, and gauge-based incentive mechanisms for liquidity providers.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Blackhole CLMM family relies on a set of factory contracts (AlgebraFactory, PairFactory, GaugeFactoryCL) to deploy pool and gauge instances, while the RouterV2 facilitates user swaps. Supporting infrastructure includes multiple CustomPoolDeployer proxies for pool creation and TransparentUpgradeableProxy instances for upgradeability across core components.
